recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit as-is. It is a narrowly scoped build-source fix that completes the Applied issue; ordinary generated artifact refresh by the FHIR build should propagate the ValueSet expansion.
issue_request: FHIR-50606 was an Applied/Persuasive CDS change request for R6 asking to add a processing-error value to the Detected Issue Status value set, defined as an error occurring during evaluation of a proposed action and distinct from unknown or entered-in-error.
initial_application: PR 3809 was represented locally by commit 905e7a8ef4133ee52222a28eb35fb061cf9e0599, which added the detectedissue-status CodeSystem concept and updated DetectedIssue.status short/comment text. Follow-up commit 46a47e604d2492e8e74a315907263b2fe2590667 updated the Event mapping exception. The ValueSet compose still enumerated only mitigated from http://hl7.org/fhir/detectedissue-status, so processing-error was not actually in the required binding.
additional_context: DetectedIssue is active in source/fhir.ini. Because valueset-detectedissue-status.xml uses restricted concept includes rather than including all local CodeSystem concepts, adding the CodeSystem concept alone did not make processing-error valid for DetectedIssue.status. Jira search found only FHIR-50606 for the processing-error DetectedIssue terms, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no conflicting or superseding discussion.
reconciliation: Added processing-error with display Processing error to the detectedissue-status include in source/detectedissue/valueset-detectedissue-status.xml, aligning the ValueSet with the existing CodeSystem concept and required DetectedIssue.status binding.
source_changes: source/detectedissue/valueset-detectedissue-status.xml: added the processing-error concept to the http://hl7.org/fhir/detectedissue-status include.
